name: mock_candid
description: Stands in for Candid Health's API so the candid plugin's claim submission, remittance posting, and patient payment flows can be tested end to end on a test instance, with remittances scripted per claim.

handlers.description: The Candid API endpoints the candid plugin calls: auth token, encounters, patient payments.
Test-control endpoints: global config, per-claim scenarios, patient payment injection, and state inspection. Requires MOCK_CANDID_API_KEY.
